Diagrams of a harness

The figure below shows the loop of a code harness: the model proposes an action, the harness runs it, and the result is added to the context for the next step. Verification happens after every action and not only at the end of the run, which is what keeps long tasks on track.

Most harnesses keep the tool list small, because every extra tool is another way for the model to make a mistake that the harness must then detect.
